examples.label: Example 1
examples.display:
meetings = [[9, 10], [10, 12], [11, 13], [14, 15]]
start    = 10
end      = 12
output   = 2

It clashes with [10, 12) and [11, 13). The meeting [9, 10) ends as the new one starts.

examples.label: Example 2
examples.display:
meetings = [[1, 5], [2, 6]]
start    = 3
end      = 4
output   = 2

A short meeting inside two long ones clashes with both.
